However, US-Iran tensions kept investors cautious as Middle East escalation lifted oil prices (WTI crude at $91.69, Brent at $95.63).

US-Iran conflict escalates: fresh strikes and retaliation, oil prices rise, Strait of Hormuz disruption concerns
Nvidia to acquire Hugging Face for $13 billion, boosting AI sector sentiment
10-year Treasury yield around 4.75% after Waller comments; VIX fell 5.79% to 14.32
